typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	EBillPreferenceArchiveFilePath as string (),
	EBillPreferenceFilePath as string (),
	EBillReaderFalloutFileName as string (),
	EBillReaderFalloutPath as string (),
	FacetsDataSource as string (),
	FacetsPassword as string (),
	FacetsUserID as string (),
	TestVaraible as string (),
	varFilePath as string ()
}

source(output(
		EBILL_EFF_DT as string,
		MESSAGE as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		EBILL_TERM_DT as string,
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT    EPS.GRGR_ID,    EPS.SBSB_ID,    EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT,    EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT,    \'Invalid Date format\' AS MESSAGE  FROM    AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF_STAGE EPS  WHERE  (  EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT IS NULL OR LENGTH(RTRIM(EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT)) <=8 OR (NOT regexp_like(EBILL_EFF_DT, \'[[:digit:]]{4}-[[:digit:]]{2}-[[:digit:]]{2}\') )  OR  (substr(EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT, 1, 4) not between \'0000\' and \'9999\' OR        substr(EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT, 6, 2) not between \'01\' and \'12\' OR        substr(EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT, 9, 2) not between \'01\' and \'31\'       )  )  OR   (EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT <> \'8888-08-08\' AND EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT IS NOT NULL AND EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT <> \' \' AND LENGTH(RTRIM(EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT)) >=8   AND ( (NOT regexp_like(EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT, \'[[:digit:]]{4}-[[:digit:]]{2}-[[:digit:]]{2}\') )  OR (substr(EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT, 1, 4) not between \'0000\' and \'9999\' OR        substr(EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT, 6, 2) not between \'01\' and \'12\' OR        substr(EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT, 9, 2) not between \'01\' and \'31\'       ) ) )  UNION ALL  Select PF1.GRGR_ID,PF1.SBSB_ID, PF1.EBILL_EFF_DT,PF1.EBILL_TERM_DT,  \'Overlapping Dates\' AS MESSAGE  from AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF_STAGE PF1  JOIN  (Select P1.GRGR_ID,P1.SBSB_ID  from AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF_STAGE P1  JOIN AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF_STAGE P2 ON P1.GRGR_ID = P2.GRGR_ID AND P1.SBSB_ID= P2.SBSB_ID AND ((P1.EBILL_EFF_DT = P2.EBILL_EFF_DT ) OR ( to_date(P1.EBILL_EFF_DT, \'yyyy-mm-dd\') >to_date(P2.EBILL_EFF_DT, \'yyyy-mm-dd\') AND  ( (  (P2.EBILL_TERM_DT = \'8888-08-08\'           OR P2.EBILL_TERM_DT IS NULL           OR LENGTH(RTRIM(P2.EBILL_TERM_DT)) <= 8 ) AND to_date(P1.EBILL_EFF_DT, \'yyyy-mm-dd\') >= to_date(\'9999-12-31\', \'yyyy-mm-dd\')  ) OR ( to_date(P1.EBILL_EFF_DT, \'yyyy-mm-dd\') <= to_date(P2.EBILL_TERM_DT, \'yyyy-mm-dd\')))) OR ( to_date(P2.EBILL_EFF_DT, \'yyyy-mm-dd\') >to_date(P1.EBILL_EFF_DT, \'yyyy-mm-dd\') AND   ( (  (P1.EBILL_TERM_DT = \'8888-08-08\'           OR P1.EBILL_TERM_DT IS NULL           OR LENGTH(RTRIM(P1.EBILL_TERM_DT)) <= 8 ) AND to_date(P2.EBILL_EFF_DT, \'yyyy-mm-dd\') >= to_date(\'9999-12-31\', \'yyyy-mm-dd\')  ) OR ( to_date(P2.EBILL_EFF_DT, \'yyyy-mm-dd\') <= to_date(P1.EBILL_TERM_DT, \'yyyy-mm-dd\')))) ) GROUP BY P1.GRGR_ID,P1.SBSB_ID Having COUNT(1)>2)  PT1 ON pt1.GRGR_ID = PF1.GRGR_ID AND  pt1.SBSB_ID = PF1.SBSB_ID  UNION ALL  SELECT    EPS.GRGR_ID,    EPS.SBSB_ID,    EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT,    EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT,    \'Invalid Dates\' AS MESSAGE      FROM    AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF_STAGE EPS  WHERE EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT <> \'8888-08-08\' AND EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(RTRIM(EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT)) >9 AND EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(RTRIM(EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT)) >9 AND  regexp_like(EBILL_TERM_DT, \'[[:digit:]]{4}-[[:digit:]]{2}-[[:digit:]]{2}\') AND  regexp_like(EBILL_EFF_DT, \'[[:digit:]]{4}-[[:digit:]]{2}-[[:digit:]]{2}\') AND  substr(EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT, 1, 4) between \'0000\' and \'9999\' AND substr(EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT, 6, 2)  between \'01\' and \'12\'  AND  substr(EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT, 9, 2) between \'01\' and \'31\' AND  substr(EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT, 1, 4) between \'0000\' and \'9999\' AND substr(EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT, 6, 2)  between \'01\' and \'12\'  AND  substr(EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT, 9, 2) between \'01\' and \'31\' AND TO_DATE(EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT, \'yyyy-mm-dd\') < TO_DATE(EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT, \'yyyy-mm-dd\') OR EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT = \'8888-08-08\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> InValidDateOverlap
InValidDateOverlap sink(input(
		EBILL_EFF_DT as string,
		MESSAGE as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		EBILL_TERM_DT as string,
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		EBILL_EFF_DT,
		MESSAGE,
		GRGR_ID,
		EBILL_TERM_DT,
		SBSB_ID)) ~> FlatFileDestination
